Proposition 1 item 2 writes '(du + dt)^2 <= (p^2 + d^2)H^2' without stating the definitions of u, t, p, d, H or the conditions u^2 + t^2 <= H^2 and d <= p.

summary: This 4-page paper presents a constructive, zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization (18 theorems; 5 zero-axiom, 13 using only [propext, Quot.sound], 0 Classical.choice, 0 sorry) and a pure-stdlib exact-rational verifier (EUCLIDEAN-DIAM-CERT-1.0) for the deterministic algebraic, geometric, variance-certificate, two-cap mask, de-amortized shrinkage, and Appendix A.1 factor-two core of Giliberti and Hajiaghayi (arXiv:2611.33139). All explicit algebraic identities, SOS decompositions, exact rational witness metrics, and Taylor threshold calculations visible in the PDF check out exactly, and the empirical audit covers 16 canonical certificates (0.181-8.834 ms) and 62/62 rejected forgery tests. The paper transparently excludes the probabilistic Gaussian-grid couplings and communication-complexity lower bounds of [3]. Its main limitations are the compressed presentation of Proposition 1 (omitting side hypotheses in prose summaries) and reliance on [3] for several symbol definitions.
weaknesses: Because the manuscript is condensed to 4 pages, several symbols referenced from [3]—such as F(t), g(t_0), F_lb(t_0), e_lb, eta_mask, r_2, s(B_kappa + 1), epsilon_0, D_univ, and P_i—are used without standalone definitions in the paper itself.

The cleared-integer / rational Lean 4 formulation avoids Mathlib real numbers (0 Classical.choice), which is sound for polynomial/rational inequalities but leaves the bridge to real-valued Euclidean norms, square roots, and suprema over R^d at the level of cleared squared forms.

The 62/62 red-team audit evaluates a self-authored adversarial test suite (tests/test_suite.py) rather than an independent external audit, and the exact Lean theorem signatures are not included in the PDF.
